technical_name: Spooler service stopped or not running

remediation.label: restart Windows' printing system
remediation.user_impact: This briefly stops and starts the printing service. It does not delete your files. Administrator permission is often required.

rollback: Restarting again returns the service to a running state in most cases.

plain_language.problem: Windows' printing system has stopped running. That's preventing your computer from sending documents to the printer.
plain_language.solution: I can try to start that printing system again. Windows may ask for administrator permission.
